from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,ast
h=Path('/home/liyufeng/safeduo/artifacts/safety_zero_intent_20261006_2225')
s=json.loads((h/'astra_zero_presentation_source_snapshot_initial.json').read_text())
replacements={'build_report.py':('最大目标漂移rad','相对初始测量q的最大已发目标位移rad'),'panel_template.html':('最大目标漂移 rad','相对初始测量q的最大已发目标位移 rad')}
rows={}
for n,row in s['sources'].items():
    data=(h/n).read_bytes();current=data.decode();old=row['text']
    if n in replacements:
        before,after=replacements[n]
        assert old.count(before)==1,n
        assert current==old.replace(before,after),n
        assert current.count(after)==1 and before not in current,n
        line=next(i for i,t in enumerate(current.splitlines(),1) if after in t)
        rows[n]=dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),prior_sha256=row['sha256'],only_declared_title_replacement=True,line=line,label=after)
    else:
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==row['sha256'],n
        rows[n]=dict(sha256=row['sha256'],unchanged=True)
ast.parse((h/'build_report.py').read_text())
assert "data['controller_target'][:60]-data['q_initial']" in (h/'audit_zero_intent.py').read_text()
assert 'maximum_target_drift_rad' in (h/'build_report.py').read_text()
assert 'maximum_target_drift_rad' in (h/'panel_template.html').read_text()
print(json.dumps(dict(status='PASS_BOUNDED_TWO_LABEL_SOURCE_CHECK',bindings=rows,audit_math_and_key_unchanged=True,new_outcome_reads=0),ensure_ascii=False))
